newsitem.title: USA: Alumax forms office of chairman.
newsitem.headline: Alumax forms office of chairman.

text.p: Alumax Inc said Tuesday its chairman and chief executive, Allen Born, has formed an Office of the Chairman with newly hired Thomas Johnston as executive vice president and the company's chief financial officer, Lawrence Frost.
Frost also was promoted to the additional post of executive vice president from senior vice president.
"The Office of the Chairman will continue development of the forward-looking strategy that has resulted in the very successful direction of Alumax," Born said.

The company said Johnston will be responsible for all Alumax primary, semi-fabricating and fabricating operations while Frost will oversee all financial and administrative functions, including corporate planning, human resources, law, investor relations, and public affairs.
The Alumax International and Alumax Materials Management divisions will also report to Frost, the company said.
Johnston previously was chairman and chief executive of Aztec Mining Co, a subsidiary of Australia's Poseidon Gold Ltd.
